subject: Federation of teams: seat-tier conversion, key mapping & provisioning
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Pierce <logan.pierce@whiteharbor.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Federation of teams: seat-tier conversion, key mapping & provisioning

Hi Logan — great to meet earlier this week. Per our call, White Harbor is planning to expand Redwood access to three new internal teams (SearchOps, Billing Integrations, and Support AI). A few quick bullets to align on scope and next steps: 

- Scope: 3 new projects (SearchOps, Billing Integrations, Support AI) that will each need a separate API key and isolated usage reporting.
- Capacity: estimate initial steady-state of ~1.2M tokens/day across the three teams, peaking to ~2.2M during integration sprints.
- Terms request: you asked about converting a portion of current seats to a tiered seat model and a short-term concession while teams ramp.

Attached is a first-pass provisioning proposal (WH-provisioning-proposal-v1.pdf) with pricing buckets and a suggested rollout window. High-level asks from our side: can procurement confirm target go-live window (week of Oct 18) and whether a single PO will cover the three teams?

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to propose two pricing options (tiered seat conversion + volume commit) — by EOD tomorrow.
2) Internal approval if any term concessions are requested (Kim/Marissa).
3) Once terms agreed, we’ll provide key mapping plan and schedule kickoff for keys-provisioning + handoff to Customer Success.

If procurement prefers, we can push the SOW amendment to DocuSign as soon as pricing is agreed — I’ve added a placeholder link in the proposal.

Thanks — I’ll loop in the pricing options shortly.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

From: Logan Pierce <logan.pierce@whiteharbor.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@whiteharbor.com
Date: 2026-09-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Federation of teams: seat-tier conversion, key mapping & provisioning

Thanks Kimberly — this captures the ask. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Purchase flow: procurement will likely issue a single PO covering the three teams, but they need a clarified pricing table that shows both the current rate, proposed tiered rates, and the temporary concession you mentioned.
- Timeline: we’re targeting the integration sprints to begin Oct 25, so keys need to be provisioned and scoped-week tested by Oct 20.
- Security: Support AI will require a restricted key with VPC egress rules; we’ll share the network contact separately.

procurement@whiteharbor.com — please advise whether you need a formal SOW amendment or if a signed DocuSign + PO will suffice.

Logan
Director, Platform Engineering
White Harbor
logan.pierce@whiteharbor.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Pierce <logan.pierce@whiteharbor.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Federation of teams: seat-tier conversion, key mapping & provisioning

Hey team — pulled together two clean options based on Logan’s timeline:

Option A — Tiered seat conversion + short ramp concession
- Convert 40% of current seats to Tier-2 pricing (lower per-token rate)
- Add three project keys with per-project reporting
- 12-month commitment with 3-month 20% ramp discount (applied to token spend for new teams)
- Estimated monthly run-rate after ramp: $18,500

Option B — Volume commit (preferred for cost predictability)
- 6-month volume commit covering projected peak (2.2M/day).
- Lower unit pricing, plus free SRE hours for the integration sprint.
- Estimated monthly run-rate after ramp: $15,800 (but requires pre-commit).

Notes: both options include technical constraints for Support AI (restricted key + VPC rules). I’ve flagged Option A for internal approval if procurement cannot commit to prepayment.

Marissa — can you sign off on a 3-month ramp concession for Option A if we need flexibility? If approved, I’ll update the SOW amendment and send to DocuSign.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Federation of teams: seat-tier conversion, key mapping & provisioning

Thanks Ben — I’m OK with the 3-month 20% ramp concession for Option A provided:

1) The concession is explicitly limited to token spend originating from the three new project keys and does not apply retroactively.
2) White Harbor commits to a 12-month overall term for the account after the ramp period.
3) We include a simple usage/regression alert threshold in the SOW so we can revisit if usage materially exceeds peak forecast.

Please add those items to the SOW amendment (SOW-amend-WH-2049.docx). Once updated, route to procurement and include a DocuSign link so they can sign + attach PO. 

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Hi Logan / Procurement — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Per Marissa’s guidance we’ve updated the SOW amendment to reflect:

• 3-month 20% ramp concession scoped to new project keys only
• 12-month overall account term following ramp period
• Usage alert thresholds and a review checkpoint at month two of ramp

Next steps: 
1) Attached SOW-amend-WH-2049.docx — Marissa approved language; please review and confirm if procurement prefers DocuSign or a signed PDF with PO.
2) Assuming signatures the week of Oct 5, we’ll provision the three project keys and share a keymap + onboarding checklist by Oct 7.
3) Kickoff call to validate VPC egress rules for Support AI — proposed slot: Oct 12, 10:00am PT (please confirm).

Attachments: SOW-amend-WH-2049.docx; WH-provisioning-proposal-v1.pdf (original attached for context).

Action items: 
- procurement@whiteharbor.com: confirm preferred signature flow (DocuSign vs signed PDF) and target PO date.
- Logan: confirm Oct 12 slot for network/VPC call or propose an alternate.
- Ben/Aditya: prepare keymap + onboarding checklist by Oct 7.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the teams onboarded quickly.

Best,
